response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial credentials (GISCollective, Green Map web GIS, FOSS4G talk) and demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput systems work using D (async I/O, fibers, caching, millions of req/s at Sociomantic). However, the role's core requirement — modern C++ (or Rust) in commercial/open-source settings — is only thinly evidenced: roughly six months of C/C++ at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university C++ audio project. The last decade is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js and D, with no Rust and no navigation/routing-tile or map-data pipeline experience. Strong engineering discipline (TDD, CI/CD, tooling, teaching) and a clear appetite for learning outside comfort zones make him a plausible stretch hire, so a screening call is reasonable, but a targeted systems/C++ assessment should gate any further progress.
strengths: Real geospatial/GIS product experience, including an open-source map-data platform
Proven low-latency, high-volume distributed backend work (async I/O, caching, microservices)
Strong testing/quality culture: TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks and workshops
concerns: Minimal recent modern C++ experience; no Rust at all
No routing, tiling, or map data pipeline / navigation guidance background
Recent roles are primarily TypeScript/Node full-stack, not systems-level engineering
